scenario: Sliding descriptive stats are EXACT over the window's raw samples, not an EWMA estimate (LSER.18.2 / LSER.16.2.1). A series carries `mean sliding 5_s`; a large outlier (100000) is observed at t=0, then three small samples (10, 20, 30) at t=6/7/8_s. The exact ring buffer (SeriesBackendRingBuffer) evicts the outlier once it falls outside the 5_s window, so `mean` drops below 1000 and the rule fires. An EWMA backing never evicts: it retains a decayed outlier contribution and keeps `mean` near ~7500 across the whole sequence, so the rule would never fire. Pin: action_log appears, proving the exact-over-raw-samples backing. It appears twice, at the 7_s and 8_s pumps: a firing reads the series as it stood when its pump began (LSER.8.6), so at 6_s the window is empty and at 7_s it holds the 6_s sample alone.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    val: Float mutable

series Reading.val:
    count sliding 5_s
    mean sliding 5_s

rule recent_mean_exact:
    Reading r where count(r.val) >= 1 and mean(r.val) < 1000.0
->
    log info "exact windowed mean"
